purpose: Persisted engine-level artifact evidence for issue #23 / F-07: SHA-256 of the committed JSON/PNG pair that `python -m engine.main` publishes for the shipped Level 1 and Level 2 sample tasks. Hashes are regression pins bound to the inputs below; they are not a Stage 1 wire field, a ranking input, or an organizer qualification result.

linux-x86_64.observed_on: Local linux/amd64 Docker run with the pinned renderer after source-role emphasis variants; native amd64 qualification for this revision remains unverified.

linux-aarch64.observed_on: Local native linux/arm64 Docker container built from the pinned Dockerfile with only the platform flag changed; two runs byte-identical. Layout JSON equals linux-x86_64; PNG bytes differ (architecture-dependent raster output).

darwin-arm64.observed_on: Local macOS arm64 run with the repository .venv (pinned dependency versions); repeated runs and different PYTHONHASHSEED values were byte-identical. Level 2 JSON differs from Linux because Skia glyph advances are fractional on macOS and hinted integers on Linux, which changes the largest fitting text font size.
